blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Matthew Rubico helped Lyceum snap a four-game losing streak with a 98-89 win over Perpetual Help in the NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball tournament at San Juan Arena on Tuesday. Rubico put on a sensational outing of 21 points, seven rebounds, four assists and a steal as the Pirates pulled away in the fourth quarter to pluck their second victory. “It was such a tight game.
